title: An operator changed an order's quantity
description: Payload of SampleOrderQuantityAdjusted. sample-orders publishes it STANDARD, TENANT-scoped, through its outbox in the unit of work of the internal contract call that changed the order (standard-link plan D125). It carries the order as it is after the change, not the difference. version is the order's version: events of different types are not ordered, so a subscriber keeps whichever of this and SampleOrderPlaced is newer (Kafka design D31). A change follows the placement, so version is at least 2. x-brix-classification marks each field (root BRX-RS-SECURITY-008).
